arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Render ONE separate green clock-arm component in the clean black-outlined Cartoon style of image2. Image1 determines the exact pose/silhouette, attachment-end location, finger direction, hand orientation and curve. Image2 is MATERIAL/INK style only; DO NOT include its watch body or face. Broad low shallow hook arm. The attachment endpoint is at LEFT near mid-height, shaft dips DOWN in its left half then rises to the hand at RIGHT. Index finger points almost horizontally RIGHT, slightly upward. Preserve the source very wide, low silhouette and visible open space above the dip. Follow the source's relative hand/arm size; keep the arm slender, smooth and flexible, not a bulky tube. One green hand, one index finger extended, other fingers folded as original. Flat saturated green with modest cel highlights/shading. No new wrist cuff, no extra arm, no watch. Smooth edges, never trace pixel stair-steps. Genuine transparent background and empty interior, no external shadow, gray haze, glow, ground, scene or text. Complete asset centered with at least5% transparent margins. Attachment end is a plain thin cutoff/taper exactly like the original, with NO enlarged round ball, button, collar or socket.
